display.attractionName: The Little Mermaid: Ariel's Undersea Adventure

description: The iron grillwork on the outside of the attraction is worked into bubbles, and some of the bubble clusters are Mickeys.

whereToLook.scene: The iron grillwork on the exterior of the building
whereToLook.exactSpot: The bubble clusters in the ironwork. Groups of three, one large and two small.

bestTip: Look at the railings and grilles while you wait, not the marquee.
